consequence.statement: The Docker provider `tls.caOptional` static option no longer exists in v3, so a configured value is not honoured; the guide says to remove it from the Docker provider static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove `tls.caOptional` (e.g. --providers.docker.tls.caOptional, providers.docker.tls.caOptional in traefik.yml/toml) from the Docker provider static configuration; configure TLS client authentication on the server side instead.

assertion.statement: In Traefik v3 the Docker provider's static-configuration option `tls.caOptional` (providers.docker.tls.caOptional) has been removed, because TLS client authentication is a server-side option; remove it from the Docker provider static configuration.
